ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit District symbols and

indications as shown on Map 26-A in the area bounded by

A line 336 feet north of and parallel to East 104th Street; a line 121.5 feet east of
and parallel to South Ewing Avenue; a line 300 feet north and parallel to East
104" Street; a line 257.03 feet east of and parallel to South Ewing Avenue; East
104" Street; South Ewing Avenue
to those of an RM 4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District and a corresponding use district is hereby

established in the area described above.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.

Common address of property: 10327 — 10359 S. Ewing Ave., 3634 — 3658 E. 104th St. and
10330 — 10358 S. Avenue J
